adjudication: Developer source comparison of original NASA pages, not independent scientific expert gold. These small matched targets are not whole-document precision or recall.
selection_basis: Three correctly attributed author conclusions versus none with fully correct scope/role on matched p37 tasks; better identity recovery in the production preflight; faster matched strict completions. Neither raw model is trusted for quantities or table interpretation. Production validators and targeted recovery remain authoritative.

defects: A21 and A23 add a gravity-condition endpoint to investigation scope.
A22 changes the source applications conclusion into guidance. A24 future research is also labeled guidance.
The p29 quantity is assigned to a FlameSpread phenomenon, not an experimental group, and its name is not literal source wording.
Table values have derived roles, but phenomenon endpoints do not establish the experimental scope.
The p29 quantity uses a material endpoint and a nonliteral quantity name; production must recover it separately with source scope.
The three linear-fit table values are incorrectly labeled reported quantities. Independent source/unit/role validation must reject these assignments.
Not every exact source anchor establishes scientific entailment.

image_diagnostic.accepted_format: OpenAI-compatible user content array with text and PNG data URL in image_url
image_diagnostic.decision: Visual input works, but demonstrated no scientific superiority for this table. Optional production image route is available via NVIDIA_SCIENCE_VISION_MODEL and disabled by default. All image context retains original PDF checksum and page; text anchors remain independently required.

lightning_baseline: Historical v3 scientific_quality_development_02.json and provider_behavior_02.json preserved; no repeated historical campaign.

ultra.reason_for_test: Concrete quantity/scope failures persisted in real primary-model frozen evaluations. One matched development task was therefore justified; no repeated campaign.
ultra.decision: Not selected: one 180-second diagnostic deadline produced no completed content; accessibility/reliability not established. Timeout is not evidence of scientific inferiority.

provider_limits: Free endpoint authorization does not establish unlimited quota, account credits, production licensing, or a verified dollar cost.
historical_selection_receipt: model_selection.json (earlier decision; optional Ultra later tested)
configuration_preservation: Local ignored .env keeps the authorized existing key and Lightning query selection; scientific extraction uses VL with Super120 transport fallback. No account or subscription changes.
